purpose: Retrospective interpretation only; never used in predictor features, cluster fitting, threshold calibration or alarm generation.

events.title: Five-minute settlement begins
events.supported_fact: NEM dispatch and financial settlement were aligned at five-minute intervals from 1 October 2021.
events.hypothesis_to_check: A market rule change may affect price distributions; examine price components around this date.
events.limitation: The project CSV already aggregates prices to half-hours. Coincidence with this date does not establish an effect on NSW demand or explain an earlier persistent alarm episode.

events.title: NEM market suspension
events.source_title: NEM market suspension and operational challenges in June 2022
events.supported_fact: Market suspension began on 15 June 2022 and was formally lifted on 24 June. The incident report identifies concurrent supply, fuel-price and winter-demand pressures.
events.hypothesis_to_check: Inspect the price and demand components during and around the suspension, allowing for the input monitor's one-day market lag and 28-day window.
events.limitation: Several pressures occurred together. An existing exceedance before the suspension cannot be attributed to the suspension, and nearby cooldown alarms are not independent change points.

events.title: Liddell retirement
events.source_title: AGL's Liddell Power Station closes after 52 years of operation
events.supported_fact: AGL announced Liddell's retirement in NSW on 28 April 2023.
events.hypothesis_to_check: A supply-side retirement is a plausible context for examining price inputs around this date.
events.limitation: The closure was announced well in advance and occurred in stages. The date does not identify an abrupt demand-shape change, and windows cannot establish causality.

long_term_context.locator: National Electricity Market chapter, printed page 20
long_term_context.supported_fact: The report relates midday negative prices to low-cost renewable generation and rooftop solar reducing net electricity demand.
long_term_context.hypothesis_to_check: Compare the released NSW data's midday demand ratio and negative-price share over time.
long_term_context.limitation: This is NEM-wide background, not NSW-specific causal identification. No solar-capacity or external generation data are imported, and no single event date is assigned to a gradual transition.

long_term_context.supported_fact: AER reported quarterly records in rooftop solar output, negative-priced half-hours and minimum daily electricity demand.
long_term_context.limitation: These broad observations supply context; they do not prove the cause of this project's input scores or a change in forecasting accuracy.
